= Passthrough substitutions
:name: Ada
:formatted: *attribute bold*
:replaceable: (C)
:url: https://example.com

== Structural forms

Single: +<tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --+

Double: ++<tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --++

Triple: +++#pagebreak() {name} *bold* (C)+++

Macro without substitutions: pass:[literal #pagebreak() {name} *bold* (C)]

Numeric reference without substitutions: pass:[&#169;]

== Individual substitutions

Special characters: pass:c[<tag> & &#169;]

Attributes: pass:a[{name} *bold*]

Quotes: pass:q[*bold* _italic_ #marked#]

Replacements: pass:r[(C) -> ... --]

Macros: pass:m[https://example.com]

Post replacements: pass:p[first +
second]

== Substitution groups

Normal: pass:n[<tag> {name} *bold* (C) https://example.com]

Normal quotes before attributes: pass:n[{formatted}]

Verbatim: pass:v[<tag> {name} *bold* (C) <1>]

== Ordered substitutions

Quotes then attributes: pass:q,a[{formatted}]

Attributes then quotes: pass:a,q[{formatted}]

Replacements then attributes: pass:r,a[{replaceable}]

Attributes then replacements: pass:a,r[{replaceable}]

Macros then attributes: pass:m,a[{url}]

Attributes then macros: pass:a,m[{url}]

== Escaping

No substitutions: pass:[\*literal*]

Quotes: pass:q[\*literal*]

Typst source stays text: pass:[literal #pagebreak() ) \ " #raw("injected")]
